title: D-Xhird
overview:
- A new system that creates an attack-focused game where "waiting" gives no advantage!!
- Ultra-high-speed and ultra-3D battles! The entire 3D space is used as the battlefield!!
- The birth of the "New Combo", where special moves are built into chain combos along with dramatic effects!!

●“待ち”の状態を有利とさせない、攻撃重視のゲームを生む新システム!!
●超高速&超立体バトル！全ての立体空間を戦闘フィールドとして使用する!!
●演出効果も合わせて、連続技の中に必殺技が盛り込まれる「ニューコンボ」誕生!!
